steps.en: Install FreeCAD from the official installer, your distro, or the AppImage
steps.zh: 用官方安装包、发行版仓库或 AppImage 装好 FreeCAD

steps.en: Ships the Qt UI, the Coin3D 3D view and the OpenCASCADE kernel in one app
steps.zh: 自带 Qt 界面、Coin3D 视图与 OpenCASCADE 内核

steps.en: Create a Body and a new Sketch on a base plane
steps.zh: 新建 Body，在基准面上新建草图

steps.en: Solves your constraints and drives the degrees of freedom to 0
steps.zh: 求解约束，把自由度压到 0

steps.en: Pad the sketch into a solid — Pocket subtracts another
steps.zh: 把草图拉成实体——Pocket 做减料

steps.en: Edit a dimension on any sketch still in the tree
steps.zh: 改动文档树里任一草图的尺寸

steps.en: Recomputes the feature history and rebuilds the part
steps.zh: 重算历史，把零件重建出来

value.en: You re-dimension one sketch and the whole part rebuilds from its own history — no redrawing
value.zh: 改一个草图的尺寸，整件零件就按自己的历史重建，不用重画
